plan.summary: A three-day Hong Kong trip built around your list: harbour views and street food in Kowloon on arrival evening, then The Peak, Tai Kwun and a Central dinner on day 2. Your only return flight leaves at 12:10 on Jan 17, so day 3 is a short early-morning stop in Tsim Sha Tsui before the airport. The Lantau day (Ngong Ping 360, Big Buddha, Po Lin, Tai O) doesn't fit.

Plan this trip and keep every named place. Party size 2, origin Taipei, 15–17 January 2027, 3 days, budget 9000, currency HKD. Stay in Tsim Sha Tsui.

Day 1 (Jan 15, Fri) | Kowloon arrival

Arrive at Hong Kong International Airport and check in at a hotel in Tsim Sha Tsui.
Ride the Star Ferry to the Avenue of Stars.
Eat at Tim Ho Wan in Sham Shui Po.
Walk Temple Street Night Market in the evening.
Day 2 (Jan 16, Sat) | Peak and Central

Take the Peak Tram and walk the Peak Circle Walk.
Ride the Central–Mid-Levels Escalator down.
Visit Tai Kwun, then have dinner in SoHo.
Day 3 (Jan 17, Sun) | Lantau, then fly home

Take Ngong Ping 360 to the Big Buddha and Po Lin Monastery.
Continue to Tai O.
Fly out of Hong Kong International Airport in the evening.

Added Central–Mid-Levels Escalator as an unconfirmed stop at 14:50.

The Central–Mid-Levels Escalator only runs downhill from about 6:00 to 10:00 am. After that it runs uphill. At 14:50 you would ride it up, or walk down beside it. For a true downhill ride you would need to do it before 10:00, which clashes with the Peak. Ho Lan Jeng is in Lan Kwai Fong, right next to SoHo. I could not find a restaurant in SoHo itself, so I left the dinner as it was.
